documentation: Each exception is bound to one advisory, exact installed version, Bun lock install path, workspace artifact, and dependency class. runtime means dependencies/optionalDependencies (including their resolved peers); development means devDependencies. Changed versions, install paths, artifacts, classes, or advisory IDs are new findings. Entries must match a current finding and are valid through expiresOn (UTC), for at most 30 days from reviewedOn. Every scope below was manually traced on 2026-08-03; no concrete reachable Critical/High production exploit was established, and the ledger remains fail-closed for feed or lockfile drift.
